entity_ranked_evidence.title: South India leads India's nursing workforce as national ratio remains below WHO benchmark - The South First
entity_ranked_evidence.snippet: # South India leads India’s nursing workforce as national ratio remains below WHO benchmark. > ***Synopsis:** Parliamentary data reveal a stark regional divide in India’s nursing workforce, with Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu accounting for nearly half of the country’s registered hospital nurses. South India has emerged as the country’s nursing powerhouse, with Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu accounting for nearly half of India’s registered hospital nursing workforce and recording some of the country’s highest nurse-population ratios, according to data tabled in Parliament. A written reply by Union Health Minister JP Nadda in the Rajya Sabha on 21 July states that India had 46.02 lakh registered nursing personnel as of 31 December 2025, translating to a nurse-population ratio of 2.60 per 1,000 people. “As per the Indian Nursing Council (INC) records, there are 46.02 lakh nursing personnel registered in the country as on 31st December, 2025, giving a nurse to population ratio of 2.60 nurses per 1000 population,” Nadda said in response to a starred question.

entity_ranked_evidence.title: CDC catches up to state tallies of cyclosporiasis cases as illness surges - The Washington Post
entity_ranked_evidence.snippet: # CDC catches up to state tallies of cyclosporiasis cases as illness surges. Domestic cases this year already exceed the total 3,955 cases reported during all of 2025. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention dramatically increased its national tally of cyclosporiasis cases Tuesday, adding more than 4,000 confirmed illnesses after weeks in which state health departments had reported substantially higher numbers than the federal government. The confirmed cases count is more than double the 1,645 cases reported last week. The CDC also said it is aware of more than 7,400 additional illnesses that require further analysis to determine whether they should be counted as domestically acquired cases. Underscoring the scale of the outbreak, the confirmed domestic cases alone already exceed the total 3,955 cyclosporiasis cases reported during all of 2025. State health departments in Michigan, Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky, West Virginia and New York have together reported more than 8,000 illnesses this summer, far more than the CDC’s national confirmed count until now.

entity_ranked_evidence.snippet: # Angels Jump on Matthew Liberatore Early, Beat St. Louis Cardinals Again. Tuesday night in Anaheim, it was Matthew Liberatore on the mound for the Cardinals and the game started like the Angels were reading his mind. To say that the game started off poorly for St. Louis would be a massive understatement. The bottom of the 1st inning would see the LA Angels jump all over Cardinals starter Matthew Liberatore as if they had foreknowledge of every pitch he was throwing. To give you an idea of how bizarre the current stretch is for the Cardinals, Iván Herrera waved off the first pitch from Matthew Liberatore in the bottom of the 6th inning when he saw the scoreboard in right field make sudden changes which were distracting so he and manager Oli Marmol appealed to the umpires to not count the first ball that Matthew tossed and they agreed.
